jobs.title: Strategy & Operations Manager, RCM
jobs.why: Excellent healthcare-operations fit: build scalable workflows, playbooks, tooling, metrics, cross-functional projects and practice operations. Kevin’s ABA/healthcare operations, intake/process work and systems-project experience map directly to the role’s generalist operator focus.
jobs.gap: RCM and MSO-PC familiarity is helpful. Kevin should emphasize transferable healthcare operations and process design experience and be prepared to learn denials, A/R, collections and claim-lifecycle concepts quickly.

jobs.title: Patient Operations Manager
jobs.why: Very strong overlap with pediatric therapy, family onboarding, patient intake, team training, CRM-driven workflows, KPI tracking and process improvement. Kevin can tell a coherent story from ABA operations through systems and staff development.
jobs.gap: Coral Care asks for 5–8 years in patient/healthcare operations and proven direct team management. HubSpot is preferred; SQL is preferred but not required, so Kevin should describe SQL only as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (up to 3 days/week in West Village)
jobs.why: Strong match for healthcare operations, project ownership, work plans, cross-functional execution, process improvement, implementations and stakeholder coordination. Kevin’s healthcare operations plus business-systems background is highly relevant.
jobs.gap: Verana prefers consulting or healthcare data/analytics experience. SQL Workbench is only a nice-to-have; Kevin should present SQL as foundational/working knowledge and lean on project delivery, process improvement and healthcare operations.

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong fit for leading operational initiatives, building scalable processes, improving metrics, managing a service-delivery team and partnering with product/engineering. Kevin’s training, onboarding, healthcare workforce and operations experience aligns well with Stepful’s student-operations model.
jobs.gap: Stepful prefers consulting or business-operations experience in a DTC startup and expects direct team leadership. Kevin should frame his training, recruiting, project leadership and healthcare operations responsibilities as the core management story.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.why: Strong mental-health operations match centered on cross-functional initiatives, scalable workflows, root-cause analysis, process design and end-to-end execution. Kevin’s ABA operations and systems/process work fit the builder profile well.
jobs.gap: Headway asks for 5+ years in high-growth operational roles and proficiency with data tools including SQL. Kevin should not overstate SQL; position it as foundational/working knowledge while emphasizing dashboards, reporting, workflow automation and operational problem solving.

jobs.title: Business Development Operations Manager - Cardiology
jobs.location: NYC · Hybrid (2 days/week; also Boston or Dallas)
jobs.why: Healthcare growth-operations role with pipeline management, reporting, process improvement, cross-functional coordination, documentation and operational infrastructure. Kevin’s healthcare background plus growth, reporting and project-management experience transfers well.
jobs.gap: The role prefers 4–7+ years in life sciences, clinical trials, business development or enterprise partnerships and experience with commercial scoping/pricing. Clinical-trial domain depth is the primary gap.

jobs.title: Systems Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong systems fit across Salesforce, workflow automation, CRM data quality, integrations, dashboards, reporting, documentation and user training. These responsibilities closely match Kevin’s Salesforce/Power Apps, automation and operations-systems experience.
jobs.gap: Commure asks for strong Salesforce administration, Salesforce CPQ and experience with ZoomInfo/Outreach. Those platform-specific requirements are the main risk; SQL is only a nice-to-have and should be described as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.why: Excellent thematic fit for healthcare AI, implementation workflows, process design, dashboards, RevOps infrastructure and cross-functional execution. Kevin’s systems/process background and healthcare experience make this a worthwhile stretch application.
jobs.gap: Ambience targets 4–8 years in consulting/BizOps/strategy or founder-operator roles with strong 0→1 delivery. The role also expects comfort reading SQL/BI output; Kevin should keep SQL positioned as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.why: Good fit for client operations, team leadership, process improvement, workflow automation and cross-functional execution in a high-growth company. Kevin’s client-facing operations, systems and project experience is relevant even though the industry is fintech rather than healthcare.
jobs.gap: January prefers enterprise financial-services/debt-management exposure and technical familiarity with APIs or workflow tooling. Domain experience is the main gap, though the operational work is transferable.
